purpose: Show the failure cases that prevent a rate-typed bridge candidate from entering testing when the declared eligibility conditions are not met.

counterexamples.counterexample: A system with zero degrees of freedom is presented as bridge-ready.
counterexamples.why_blocked: The screen requires DOF(x) > 0 before any bridge testing is admitted.

counterexamples.counterexample: A decoupled A|E relation is evaluated as if it were coupled.
counterexamples.why_blocked: The screen requires a coupled A|E relation, not a decoupled one.

counterexamples.counterexample: The reference phi is omitted or left implicit.
counterexamples.why_blocked: The screen is reference-relative and must be declared before evaluation.

counterexamples.counterexample: The candidate is checked only at the endpoints and not in the ordered interior.
counterexamples.why_blocked: The screen requires an ordered intermediate relation, not endpoint-only checking.
counterexamples.governance_effect: Reject until the ordered relation is supplied.

counterexamples.counterexample: The endpoint relation conflicts with the declared reference.
counterexamples.why_blocked: Endpoint compatibility is required before bridge testing begins.
counterexamples.governance_effect: Reject until the endpoint relation is repaired.

counterexamples.counterexample: The candidate declares closure without any generative exclusion step.
counterexamples.why_blocked: The screen requires exclusion before closure so the candidate does not collapse into narrative.

blocked_readings: A rate-typed screen pass is not proof.
A rate-typed screen pass is not promotion.
A rate-typed screen failure does not invalidate RT_core.
A rate-typed screen failure does not establish external truth.
forbidden_inference: The counterexamples do not prove the bridge is impossible.
The counterexamples do not define a completed metric.
The counterexamples do not modify RT_core.

non_claims: Does not prove bridge failure in general.
Does not prove a completed metric is impossible.
Does not assert external physical truth.
